text: Delroy - off to Jamaica 14 May, 3 wks, first time back in 10 yrs. going for his gran's 95th, whole family flying in from Toronto + Birmingham. he's worried she's frail, had a fall at Easter. Delroy's partner Ann can't go, work. remind me to ask how his gran is when he's back + get the rum recipe lol

Ann's mum in hosp again w/ chest infection - 2nd time since Aug. on IV antibiotics, docs say maybe home Mon if bloods ok. Ann v tired, doing nights there + working days, her brother Reggie useless, lives in Glasgow and hasn't been down once. she cried a bit on the phone. check in Fri, offer to cover the school pickup Thurs
Tobi mad on Arsenal, season ticket since he was 12. hates Spurs chat lol
Shreya - knitting a jumper for her niece, 2nd attempt, first one came out huge
flights to Lisbon booked for 3rd of June. need passport renewed before then!!
Carlos twisted ankle @ 5 a side Tues. on crutches til next wk prob. his wife Sofia doing all the school runs
Noor + Farid - honeymoon Bali 22/09 - 6/10. 17hr flight, Noor dreads flying. text her good luck the day before
Sophie's son Reggie has chickenpox, off nursery all wk. she's going stir crazy
Kalani - into bouldering now, goes 3x a wk. wants new climbing shoes for bday (size 6!)

Seo-yeon learning Portuguese on Duolingo, 200 day streak. trip to Brazil next spring
remind me to ask Connor how the Lake District walk went - did Scafell w/ his brother Lukas Sat
Yetunde - choir concert 30 Nov @ St Mary's. solo part, she's bricking it. should go if I can
Chen - collects vinyl, mainly 70s jazz. mentioned wanting a Coltrane first press, gift idea
dentist moved to next Wed 9.15

Emily back from Japan last wk - jet lag awful, still waking at 4am. 2 wks: Tokyo, Kyoto, Hiroshima, then Osaka for the last few days. loved Kyoto most, stayed in a ryokan, said the food was unreal. her bf Julien got food poisoning in Osaka tho, lost 2 days. they want to go back for cherry blossom, maybe April after next
Arturo's daughter broke her wrist on trampoline. cast for 6 wks. poor kid, she's 7
Eva - running Berlin marathon 27/09. 1st one. training going ok but knee niggling. msg her the wk before
Aditi - Dr Banerjee to her patients lol. just started @ Royal Free, cardiology
Julien's cat Biscuit missing since Sun. posters up round Elm Rd. check if he's turned up
Abebe - Ethiopia trip for his cousin's wedding, flies out a fortnight tomorrow. back 2nd Jan
Lila + Ruby - board game night every other Thurs, Ruby obsessed w/ Wingspan. next one 6th
Bogdan's mum diagnosed w/ diabetes. he's v stressed, she lives in Bucharest so hard to help. don't forget to call him this weekend
Sam - holiday to Crete cancelled, work wouldn't sign off leave. gutted
Delroy's band playing @ Fiddler's Elbow Sat 18th. he's on bass. might go
Anika - bad migraine all wk, off work since Mon. GP tomorrow. text her after

Tendai into Warhammer 40k - painting a whole Ultramarines army, 2000 pts, been going since lockdown. does it Sun mornings w/ his son, who's more into the Orks. showed me pics, actually amazing, uses an airbrush now. tournament in Nottingham 8/02, first one, he says he'll get crushed. wants the new codex, came out last wk - gift idea for Xmas
Shreya's dad - cataract op on 12/11. she's taking him. ask how it went
Carlos Garcia (Carlitos) - new kitchen fitter recommended by Sofia. cheap but slow
Noor allergic to nuts - remember for Sat bbq
Sophie + her husband off to NYC for 40th, 5th-10th Dec. kids w/ grandparents. must get her a card
buy sun cream + adaptor before Fri
Eamon - Liverpool fan, wife Everton. derby on Sun = house divided apparently
Seo-yeon's brother Chen in hosp w/ appendicitis, op went ok last night. she's flying to Seoul Thurs to see him. check in w/ her next wk
Connor - nervous about long-haul to Sydney 18 Jan, 24hrs total. first time flying alone. maybe send him some podcast recs
Yetunde's son Tobi - got into county u14 squad!! she's so proud. congratulate him next time
Mrs Walsh next door - knee replacement Tues. offered to walk her dog Rolo while she recovers
Ann - massive Taylor Swift fan, went to all 3 Wembley nights. dropping hints about the vinyl box set

Farid quit cricket club, said his back can't take it anymore - slipped disc diagnosed in summer. physio twice a wk now, Tues + Fri. gutted bc he's been there 15 yrs, was captain of the 2nds. says he'll still do teas + scoring. his wife Aditi relieved tbh. club dinner 29 Nov, they're giving him a send off
Emily's mum - stroke on Sun. stable, in Northwick Park. Emily not ok. need to ring her tonight, maybe drop food round Thurs

Arturo + Lila - Iceland roadtrip in a fortnight, 10 days, ring road in a campervan. Arturo wants northern lights pics, bought a new camera + tripod, been watching YouTube tutorials every night. Lila less keen on the camping bit in November, she gets cold. flight Tues 4th from Gatwick, 6am. should lend them my thermal flask + ask for pics after
Eva - sourdough phase. starter called Doughy lol
Aditi - says she's burnt out, 3 night shifts in a row. holiday booked to Goa 2 Feb, can't come soon enough
Julien - Biscuit found!! was in neighbour's shed 4 days. vet check Mon, bit thin
Abebe reading all the Discworld books in order, on no. 23. said Night Watch is his fave so far
Ruby - sciatica flare up, can barely sit. physio Wed. struggling at work cos desk job

Bogdan - back from Bucharest Sun after 2 wks w/ his mum. she's doing better, new meds working, sugar levels down. his aunt moving in w/ her for now which helps. flight back was a nightmare - 4hr delay at Otopeni + lost bag. still no bag. he's going back in Feb for her 70th. ask him if the bag turned up

Sam's sister Abigail - pregnant!! due 3rd of March. Sam gonna be an uncle, v excited, already bought a tiny Celtic kit. Abigail had awful morning sickness first 3 months, better now. her husband Lukas painting the nursery this weekend. baby shower 24/01 maybe. Sam wants to chip in for a pram w/ the cousins - say yes
Delroy - Tottenham Hotspur forever, sadly. birthday 9/07, wd love a retro shirt
Anika's son - flu, 3rd time this term. Anika thinking of keeping him off til Mon. her husband away in Dubai for work til Fri so she's on her own
Tendai - Lisbon stag do cancelled, groom got cold feet. wedding off too. awkward
me - gym Mon/Wed/Fri from next wk. no excuses
Kalani and her gf Eva moving to Lisbon in spring, both remote. leaving do prob April. Kalani says she'll miss her book club most

Shreya - learning ukulele, practises every night, neighbours not thrilled. recital @ the community centre 15/12, first time playing in front of people, v nervous. must text her good luck that morning. her teacher Lukas also playing

called Eamon - his son Connor broke his collarbone @ rugby Sat. surgery maybe Wed, waiting on the consultant. Eamon blaming himself bc he pushed him to join. Connor gutted, season over. their holiday to Spain next month prob off too. should send Connor a card + maybe some games for the Switch, he's into Zelda
Sofia Barros - travel nurse, just back from 6 months in Dubai. starts at Leeds General 1st Nov. says Dubai summer was unbearable, 47 degrees. wants to do NZ next. remind me to ask how first wk goes

Yetunde's mum flying in from Lagos 20 Dec for Christmas, staying til mid Jan. Yetunde's dad not well enough to travel this time, heart thing. Yetunde a bit low about it. need to ask her round for dinner one evening while her mum's here

long chat w/ Abigail - Tobi's moving to Toronto for work 4th Jan, she's not going yet, visa stuff. long distance for 6 months at least. she's putting a brave face on it but v anxious. their dog Pepper staying w/ her. her parents think she shd just go. don't forget to check in after he leaves
Noor - fave band Fontaines DC, seen them 6 times. gig in Dublin 21/03, she's flying over w/ her sister. jealous
nothing much today, cancelled plans w/ Chen. rescheduled for next Sun
